title: Values at the argument and capture slots
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $\alpha$ be a type, and assign values $\mathrm{arg},\mathrm{cap}\in\alpha$ and data, visited-mark, and origin-mark values in $\alpha$ to each source tape of $M$. For either of the two roles $i$ (argument or capture), the layout at that role's physical index is $\mathrm{arg}$ when $i$ is the argument role and $\mathrm{cap}$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
argument and capture values lie in $\alpha$
data, visited-mark, and origin-mark values in $\alpha$ are assigned to every source tape
$i$ is one of the two roles
replaced:
For every assignment of per-slot values, the clean-call layout evaluated at the argument
slot gives the argument value and evaluated at the capture slot gives the capture value.
